facts.fact: Gavi's programme audit, on site in August 2024, records that in one district visited the district immunisation officer receives the monthly activity reports of 16 health centres and keys them into DHIS2 himself, and that in N'Djamena Centre district (14 health centres, 7 of them private) entry into DHIS2 is likewise done at the district from the monthly vaccination reports the health centres send.

Gavi's programme audit states that the health ministry (MSPP) began moving data management from the manual DVDMT tool to DHIS2 in 2019, that a note of November 2023 from the ministry's Secretary-General to the provincial health delegates required exclusive use of DHIS2, and that the migration was complete only from January 2024.
